verses.greek: Δικαιωθέντες οὖν ἐκ πίστεως εἰρήνην ἔχομεν πρὸς τὸν θεὸν διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
verses.literal: Having been justified therefore by faith peace we have with the God through the Lord of us Jesus Christ
verses.dgt: Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.greek: διʼ οὗ καὶ τὴν προσαγωγὴν ἐσχήκαμεν τῇ πίστει εἰς τὴν χάριν ταύτην ἐν ᾗ ἑστήκαμεν, καὶ καυχώμεθα ἐπʼ ἐλπίδι τῆς δόξης τοῦ θεοῦ·
verses.literal: through whom also the access we have had the by faith into the grace this in which we have stood and we boast in hope of the glory the of God.
verses.dgt: through whom we also have obtained access by faith into this grace in which we stand, and we boast in hope of the glory of God.

verses.greek: οὐ μόνον δέ, ἀλλὰ καὶ καυχώμεθα ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσιν, εἰδότες ὅτι ἡ θλῖψις ὑπομονὴν κατεργάζεται,
verses.literal: Not only so now but also we glory in the tribulations knowing that the tribulation perseverance produces
verses.dgt: And not only this, but we also boast in afflictions, knowing that affliction produces endurance,

verses.greek: ἡ δὲ ὑπομονὴ δοκιμήν, ἡ δὲ δοκιμὴ ἐλπίδα.
verses.literal: the And perseverance character the and character hope
verses.dgt: and endurance proven character, and proven character hope.

verses.greek: ἡ δὲ ἐλπὶς οὐ καταισχύνει· ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν διὰ πνεύματος ἁγίου τοῦ δοθέντος ἡμῖν.
verses.literal: the And hope not does make us ashamed because the love the of God has been poured out into the hearts of us through the Spirit Holy the One having been given to us.
verses.dgt: And hope does not put us to shame, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

verses.greek: Ἔτι γὰρ Χριστὸς ὄντων ἡμῶν ἀσθενῶν ἔτι κατὰ καιρὸν ὑπὲρ ἀσεβῶν ἀπέθανεν.
verses.literal: Yet for Christ being of us without strength still according to the right time for the ungodly died
verses.dgt: For while we were still weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

verses.greek: μόλις γὰρ ὑπὲρ δικαίου τις ἀποθανεῖται· ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ τάχα τις καὶ τολμᾷ ἀποθανεῖν·
verses.literal: Rarely indeed for a righteous man anyone will die on behalf of though the good man perhaps someone even would dare to die
verses.dgt: For scarcely will someone die for a righteous person; though perhaps for the good person someone might even dare to die.

verses.greek: συνίστησιν δὲ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀγάπην εἰς ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς ὅτι ἔτι ἁμαρτωλῶν ὄντων ἡμῶν Χριστὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἀπέθανεν.
verses.literal: Demonstrates however the His own love to us the God that still sinners when being we Christ for us died.
verses.dgt: But God demonstrates his own love toward us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

verses.greek: πολλῷ οὖν μᾶλλον δικαιωθέντες νῦν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ σωθησόμεθα διʼ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς.
verses.literal: Much therefore more having been justified now by the blood of Him we will be saved through Him from the wrath!
verses.dgt: Much more, then, having now been justified by his blood, we will be saved through him from the wrath.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ ἐχθροὶ ὄντες κατηλλάγημεν τῷ θεῷ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ, πολλῷ μᾶλλον καταλλαγέντες σωθησόμεθα ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτοῦ·
verses.literal: If for enemies being we were reconciled the to God through the death of the Son of Him much more having been reconciled will we be saved in the life of Him!
verses.dgt: For if, while being enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, having been reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

verses.greek: οὐ μόνον δέ, ἀλλὰ καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν τῷ θεῷ διὰ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, διʼ οὗ νῦν τὴν καταλλαγὴν ἐλάβομεν.
verses.literal: Not only so now but also we are rejoicing in the God through the Lord of us Jesus Christ through whom now the reconciliation we have received.
verses.dgt: And not only this, but also boasting in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

verses.greek: Διὰ τοῦτο ὥσπερ διʼ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἡ ἁμαρτία εἰς τὸν κόσμον εἰσῆλθεν καὶ διὰ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὁ θάνατος, καὶ οὕτως εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους ὁ θάνατος διῆλθεν ἐφʼ ᾧ πάντες ἥμαρτον—
verses.literal: Because of this just as through one man the sin into the world entered and through the sin the death also thus to all men the death passed for that all sinned
verses.dgt: Therefore, just as through one man sin entered into the world, and through sin death, and so death passed to all people, because all sinned—

verses.greek: ἄχρι γὰρ νόμου ἁμαρτία ἦν ἐν κόσμῳ, ἁμαρτία δὲ οὐκ ἐλλογεῖται μὴ ὄντος νόμου,
verses.literal: Until for the law sin was in the world sin however not is imputed not there being law
verses.dgt: for until law sin was in the world, but sin is not counted when there is no law.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ἐβασίλευσεν ὁ θάνατος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ μέχρι Μωϋσέως καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς μὴ ἁμαρτήσαντας ἐπὶ τῷ ὁμοιώματι τῆς παραβάσεως Ἀδάμ, ὅς ἐστιν τύπος τοῦ μέλλοντος.
verses.literal: Nevertheless reigned the death from Adam until Moses even over those not having sinned in the likeness of the transgression of Adam who is a type of the coming One.
verses.dgt: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who did not sin in the likeness of Adam’s transgression, who is a pattern of the one to come.

verses.greek: Ἀλλʼ οὐχ ὡς τὸ παράπτωμα, οὕτως καὶ τὸ χάρισμα· εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι οἱ πολλοὶ ἀπέθανον, πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἡ χάρις τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἡ δωρεὰ ἐν χάριτι τῇ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς τοὺς πολλοὺς ἐπερίσσευσεν.
verses.literal: But is not like the trespass so also the gift. If for by the of the one trespass the many died how much more the grace the of God and the gift in grace which is of the one man Jesus Christ to the many did abound!
verses.dgt: But the gracious gift is not like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift in the grace of the one man Jesus Christ abound to the many.

verses.greek: καὶ οὐχ ὡς διʼ ἑνὸς ἁμαρτήσαντος τὸ δώρημα· τὸ μὲν γὰρ κρίμα ἐξ ἑνὸς εἰς κατάκριμα, τὸ δὲ χάρισμα ἐκ πολλῶν παραπτωμάτων εἰς δικαίωμα.
verses.literal: And is not as through one having sinned the gift That indeed for judgment was of one was unto condemnation the however the gift is out of many trespasses unto justification.
verses.dgt: And the gift is not like what came through one who sinned. For the judgment from one trespass led to condemnation, but the gracious gift from many trespasses led to justification.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι ὁ θάνατος ἐβασίλευσεν διὰ τοῦ ἑνός, πολλῷ μᾶλλον οἱ τὴν περισσείαν τῆς χάριτος καὶ τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς δικαιοσύνης λαμβάνοντες ἐν ζωῇ βασιλεύσουσιν διὰ τοῦ ἑνὸς Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: If for by the of the one trespass the death reigned through the one how much more those the excess the of grace and of the gift the of righteousness receiving in life will reign through the one Jesus Christ!
verses.dgt: For if by the trespass of the one death reigned through the one, much more will those receiving the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς διʼ ἑνὸς παραπτώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς κατάκριμα, οὕτως καὶ διʼ ἑνὸς δικαιώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς δικαίωσιν ζωῆς·
verses.literal: So then just as through one trespass to all men it is unto condemnation so also through one act of righteousness to all men it is unto justification of life.
verses.dgt: So then, as through one trespass came condemnation to all people, so also through one righteous act came justification of life to all people.

verses.greek: ὥσπερ γὰρ διὰ τῆς παρακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἁμαρτωλοὶ κατεστάθησαν οἱ πολλοί, οὕτως καὶ διὰ τῆς ὑπακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς δίκαιοι κατασταθήσονται οἱ πολλοί.
verses.literal: For as for through the disobedience of the one man sinners were made the many so also through the obedience of the One righteous will be made the many.
verses.dgt: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were constituted sinners, so also through the obedience of the one the many will be constituted righteous.

verses.greek: νόμος δὲ παρεισῆλθεν ἵνα πλεονάσῃ τὸ παράπτωμα· οὗ δὲ ἐπλεόνασεν ἡ ἁμαρτία, ὑπερεπερίσσευσεν ἡ χάρις,
verses.literal: The law now entered so that may abound the trespass where however abounded the sin overabounded the grace
verses.dgt: Now law came in alongside so that the trespass might increase, but where sin increased, grace abounded all the more,

verses.greek: ἵνα ὥσπερ ἐβασίλευσεν ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ, οὕτως καὶ ἡ χάρις βασιλεύσῃ διὰ δικαιοσύνης εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
verses.literal: so that just as reigned the sin in the death so also the grace may reign through righteousness unto life eternal through Jesus Christ the Lord of us.
verses.dgt: so that just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness into eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
